# Repository instructions

Read and follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md`. The full task continuation
contract is `docs/agents/CONTINUE.md`; canonical state lives in
`project/state.json` and `project/evidence.json`.

Run the state validator and `next --json` before selecting work. Preserve the
distinction between synthetic research tests and measured instrument fidelity.
Use current user authorization and the integrator's assigned file scope. Do not
duplicate or silently override the canonical operating contract here.
